source_name: CRPS — Centralni registar privrednih subjekata (Central Registry of Business Entities)
organization: Uprava prihoda i carina (Revenue and Customs Administration), tax.gov.me
rate_limits: current portal (eprijava.tax.gov.me/TaxisPortal) returns HTTP 503; legacy crps.me is a parked domain; no open bulk/API
notes: The official Montenegro company register, run by the Revenue and Customs Administration (CRPS, crps@tax.gov.me). Authoritative for identity (name, PIB, registration number, legal form, status, founders) and the place where annual financial statements are filed. BUT: legacy crps.me is parked, and the current eprijava.tax.gov.me/TaxisPortal returns HTTP 503 (down) — no working open access at investigation time. No open bulk/API. Field model from public knowledge; no values captured.

organization: Ministarstvo javne uprave (Ministry of Public Administration) via data.gov.me
notes: Working CKAN open dataset listing PUBLIC/STATE enterprises (name, status, type, founder, address, website). Real entities (Investiciono-razvojni fond A.D., CGES AD, Luka Bar AD, Pošta CG AD, Plantaže AD, MONTECARGO AD…). NOT the full register and NO PIB/registration number (those are held by CRPS). Openly licensed.

organization: Government of Montenegro / Ministry of Public Administration
notes: Working CKAN portal, but does NOT host the company register — only statistical aggregates (MONSTAT: construction activity, average wages, agriculture census) and niche registers (seed/phytosanitary). Useful for sector statistics, not company-level identity.
Statistical business register and economy statistics — aggregate (by sector/size), not company-level. Useful for context only.
